title: ActorDeclare payload
description: Typed payload for the actor-declare operation kind (registry code 12, reserved). Introduces a logical actor into the canonical actor registry; later operations reference `declared_actor_id` as their `actor_id`. The runtime aideon_actors table is a projection rebuilt from these declarations, so deleting .aideon/runtime/ and rebuilding restores enough to interpret every operation's provenance (ADR-0038). DESIGN-INTENT: this kind is not yet an OpType variant in crates/mneme_core/src/ops.rs (the code has 1-11); code 12 is reserved for it. The asserting identity is a logical actor, never a device — no device_id appears here. Encoded per the canonical-JSON profile: all fields present, UUIDs lower-case hyphenated.

declared_actor_id.description: The opaque, stable, device-independent UUID of the logical actor being declared. Scoped to the workspace as (workspace_id, actor_id); never reused, never derived from a name, email, or machine.

actor_kind.description: What kind of logical actor this is: a human (`person`), an import job (`import`), an AI process (`ai`), a connector run (`connector`), or the system (`system`).

display_name.description: Human-readable label for the actor. Never used to infer actor equivalence; identity is the declared_actor_id alone.
